verdict.rationale: stagewise documents a plugin system with integrations for third-party services (GitHub, Supabase, Figma) that the agent can use, and plugin commands can be invoked from chat. Nothing shows these are partner-built agent apps rather than integrations with partner services. missing for 10: evidence of third-party/partner-built agent apps or a partner ecosystem/marketplace, documentation on installing or authoring external plugins, workflow orchestration with external agent apps, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
